notes: New: real CPU die temperature, per-core temperature and core power through the signed PawnIO driver, which Setup installs from our pinned copy. WinRing0 and NovaPowerBridge.exe are removed.

New: package power from Windows' own Energy Meter on every machine; GPU hotspot, memory junction, fan, voltage and VRAM; drive temperature and health; motherboard fans and board temperature where the chip is supported; a live CPU clock.
Change: the Windows ACPI temperature is no longer shown as the CPU temperature. A missing or blocked driver shows those readings as unavailable and reports one fleet event.
Fix: a drive whose hardware name is empty no longer makes the whole sensor batch unreadable.
